---
name: 🚀 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for CodeQuest 3D
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]
assignees: ""
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise summary of the proposed feature or improvement.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a learning obstacle or user experience gap? Please describe.
*Example: "Students often struggle to understand recursion stack frames without seeing recursive calls visually stacked."*

## Proposed Solution
A detailed description of what you want to see happen and how the feature should behave.

## Pedagogical & Educational Value
How will this feature make learning Data Structures and Algorithms more engaging, intuitive, or memorable for learners?

## Mockups / Visual References (Optional)
If applicable, share rough UI sketches, ASCII wireframes, or reference links.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, such as prospective tech stack impact or related issues.
